description: Test vectors of protocol v1 (protocol.md section 13). Generated by `cargo run -p credential-enclave-protocol --bin vectors` from fixed inputs. Byte values are base64url without padding. A key ending in `_text` holds the same bytes as UTF-8 text. An `hpke_seed` is the input keying material of the HPKE ephemeral key pair: the pair is DeriveKeyPair(hpke_seed) of RFC 9180 section 7.1.3.
